mapper.select: SELECT U.ID AS USER_ID ,U.EMAIL ,U.NICKNAME ,B.ENABLED_YN ,B.LAST_SENT_DAY FROM T_USER U LEFT JOIN T_MORNING_BRIEF B ON B.USER_ID = U.ID WHERE 1=1 AND U.ID = #{userId} AND U.DEL_DAY IS NULL

SELECT B.USER_ID ,U.EMAIL ,U.NICKNAME FROM T_MORNING_BRIEF B JOIN T_USER U ON U.ID = B.USER_ID WHERE 1=1 AND B.ENABLED_YN = 'Y' AND U.EMAIL LIKE '%@%' AND U.DEL_DAY IS NULL AND (B.LAST_SENT_DAY IS NULL OR B.LAST_SENT_DAY < #{today}) ORDER BY B.USER_ID
